desc: Key Applications: Artificial Intelligence (AI), High Availability Storage, NVMe Over Fabrics Solution
Key Features: Two hot-pluggable systems (nodes) in a 2U form factor. Each node supports the following:
Single Socket E (LGA-4677) 5th/4th Generation Intel® Xeon® Scalable processor. Up to 350W TDP.
Supports 8 DIMMs per node with 1DPC, up to 2TB memory capacity with 8 DIMMs of 256GB 3DS RDIMM DDR5-5600 ECC memory per node.
Dedicated 1GbE Private Ethernet connection for node-to-node communication (Heartbeat)
24 Hot-swap Dual Port Gen 5 U.2 NVMe SSD bays

desc: 24 U.2 Dual Port NVMe Storage Bays
This system needs to have minimum 1 Dual Port Drive. Parts for the 2 nodes must be mirrored to each other
notes: Note: Due to configurator limitations only even number of drives can be populated, for those who want to only equip the system with minimum quantity of drives or odd numbers of drives, please remark the desired drive quantity on the "order notes" in the final configuration section.
